description: Single-phase 2D channel between no-slip walls with constant-discharge inflow (B 60 1, W 10 = 0.025 m3/s through the 1 m x 0.05 m inflow, i.e. 0.5 m/s) and outflow. After the projection the velocity must be divergence-free in every cell, including the inflow and outflow columns: max |div u|. History: 0.29 in the inflow column before the Neumann pressure correction at the inflow, 9e-4 in the outflow column until the implicit diffusion coupled the wall/outflow ghost cells implicitly; now ~1e-6.
